functions.name: ComputeCollisionAudioFeedback
functions.summary: Computes the collision-response intensity used for audio feedback. Stores the collision parameter and the position/velocity pair into this, then asks the collision object (held at this+0x54) whether the contact type is valid; when it is, the intensity multiplier from the collision object is scaled by a2 and clamped to [0,1]. When intensity is zero the response is cleaned up via this's own vtable and 1 is returned; otherwise the position delta between the collision point and the collision object's reference position is computed into a7 with its magnitude into a6, and 0 is returned. Called by MilesAudioSamplePlaybackSetup.

Otherwise compute the position delta into a7 as a4 minus the collision object's reference position (offsets 0x58/0x5C/0x60 of the object pointed to by this+0x54), then set a6 to sqrt of the sum of squared delta components.
Return 1 on the no-collision cleanup path and 0 on the active collision path.
